workflow:
name: ecq-v38-platform-conformance
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/ecq-v38]
    paths: [.github/workflows/ecq-v38-conformance.yml, .github/workflows/ecq-v38-probe-reusable.yml]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  typed-reuse:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        version: ['18', '20']
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ecq-v38-probe-reusable.yml
    with:
      label: ${{ matrix.version }}
      flag: false
  expressions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Record concrete expression controls
        env:
          OBSERVATIONS: >-
            {"caseInsensitive":${{ 'A' == 'a' }},"emptyZero":${{ '' == 0 }},"boolZero":${{ false == 0 }},"missingNull":${{ github.event.nonexistent == null }},"missingFalse":${{ github.event.nonexistent == false }},"operandFallback":${{ toJSON('' || 'fallback') }},"operandAnd":${{ toJSON('yes' && 'value') }},"arrayTruthy":${{ !!fromJSON('[]') }},"hexString":${{ '0xff' == 255 }},"spaceZero":${{ ' ' == 0 }}}
          IDENTITY_JSON: >-
            {"workflowSha":"${{ github.workflow_sha }}","workflowRef":"${{ github.workflow_ref }}","sha":"${{ github.sha }}","repository":"${{ github.repository }}","runId":"${{ github.run_id }}","runAttempt":"${{ github.run_attempt }}","eventName":"${{ github.event_name }}"}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$OBSERVATIONS" > expressions.json
          printf '%s\n' "$IDENTITY_JSON" > identity.json
          python -c 'import json; x=json.load(open("expressions.json")); assert x["caseInsensitive"] and x["emptyZero"] and x["operandFallback"]=="fallback" and x["operandAnd"]=="value"'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: expression-observations
          path: |
            expressions.json
            identity.json
          retention-days: 7
  tolerated:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Deliberate tolerated failure control
        run: exit 17
  failure-after-tolerated:
    needs: tolerated
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - run: echo failure-status-control
  success-after-tolerated:
    needs: tolerated
    if: success()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - run: echo success-status-control
  matrix:
    name: Matrix control
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        axis: [a, b]
        include:
          - axis: a
            extra: metadata
    steps:
      - run: echo controlled
  before-matrix:
    if: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    strategy:
      matrix:
        axis: [a, b]
    steps:
      - run: echo unreachable
  skipped:
    if: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - run: echo unreachable
  implicit-after-skipped:
    needs: skipped
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - run: echo unreachable
  inspector:
    if: always()
    needs: [expressions, tolerated, matrix, before-matrix, skipped, implicit-after-skipped]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Record needs aggregation
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$NEEDS_JSON" > needs.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: needs-observations
          path: |
            needs.json
          retention-days: 7

./.github/workflows/ecq-v38-probe-reusab.workflow:
name: ecq-v38-owned-reusable-probe
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      label:
        type: string
        required: true
      flag:
        type: boolean
        default: true
jobs:
  observe:
    name: Typed ${{ inputs.label }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - env:
          INPUTS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(inputs) }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$INPUTS_JSON" > inputs.json
          python -c 'import json; x=json.load(open("inputs.json")); assert isinstance(x["label"],str) and x["flag"] is False'
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: input-observations-${{ inputs.label }}
          path: inputs.json
          retention-days: 7
